alex_w: Morning handoff — I'm on for the 00:00-08:00 UTC window. Quick items to watch: pool 'a100-prod-1' has been trending ~78% P95 GPU util overnight, we hit burst cap (~90%) briefly yesterday during AcmeCorp's nightly ETL. There's a scheduled heavy embedding job for AcmeCorp at 04:30 UTC (they confirmed). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/in/gpuprod/dashboards/a100-prod-1 — check P95 and queue length. If you see sustained >92% for 5+ minutes, escalate here and consider temporary burst override or model fallback. I'll be offline after 08:00 UTC — leaving primary to whoever picks this thread. :wave:
samira: Ack, I'll take primary. Thanks for the heads-up. Do we have a short runbook for the burst override?
priya_kapoor: FYI I traced yesterday's spikes — they line up with AcmeCorp embedding job: batch-size=2048 in their job config. I asked their SE to drop to 512 or 1024 for this run. If they refuse, we should prefer model-fallback to a smaller quantized variant for their requests.
marco: Re cost note — if we enable override, please set a 1h expiry and notify billing. We don't want open-ended burst for big clients.
capacity-bot: [automated] Scheduled job: AcmeCorp embedding at 04:30 UTC. Expected token load: ~1.2B tokens over 30m.
samira: Can someone paste the CLI for doing a temporary burst override?
alex_w: Sure — quick steps below. I run these if we decide to override for a customer, but prefer fallback first.

# temp burst override (set expiry 1h)
rwctl pool override --pool a100-prod-1 --customer acmecorp --multiplier 1.5 --expires 1h --reason "nightly ETL surge"
# revert
rwctl pool override-revoke --pool a100-prod-1 --customer acmecorp

priya_kapoor: Also keep an eye on queue time metric (console -> routing -> queues). If queue_time > 30s for 3m, trigger fallback policy 'model-fallback-fp16' in console.
capacity-bot: [alert] 1768002600 — a100-prod-1 GPU util 95% for 7m, queue_time peaked 42s. Notified eng-oncall.
samira: Saw the bot alert. I've toggled fallback to fp16-quant for non-SLA customers (console -> rollouts -> activate fallback). Leaving a note in the rollout description: "auto-fallback for AcmeCorp surge 04:35 UTC".
marco: Good. Samira, if you enable the override, please paste the rwctl output here and start the 1h timer. I'll cc billing.
samira: Override skipped for now — fallback brought queue_time down to 12s within 2m. Monitoring. :thumbsup:
alex_w: Awesome, thanks. If it creeps back up after Acme's window (04:30-05:00), consider reaching out to SE to stagger their shards. I've left a grafana annotation at 04:35 showing our action.
priya_kapoor: Noted. I'll follow up with SE in the am to recommend smaller batches/rolling schedule.
marco: I'll keep billing on standby. If costs spike, we'll revert and notify the customer about scheduling.
samira: All good for now. If it flares again, I'll escalate to oncall-sre. Otherwise I'll hand back primary to alex before 08:00 UTC.
alex_w: Thanks — leaving a short checklist: 1) watch P95 and queue_time, 2) prefer fallback, 3) use rwctl override only with 1h expiry, 4) notify billing if override used, 5) follow up with SE about batching. Backups: @marco for billing, @priay_kapoor for SE follow-up.
capacity-bot: [status] 1768004200 — util returned to 66%, queue_time 6s. Closing surge window.
samira: Closing out on my side — no further action. Handing back to alex. :white_check_mark:
